sections.title: The product to build
sections.review: Complete local product; rank and superiority are measurable objectives, not promised outcomes.

sections.title: Research findings that change the design
sections.review: Research findings drive optional adapters and separately scoped comparable baselines; source claims are not our measured performance.

sections.title: Architecture and language choice
sections.review: Locked Python/React/SQL stack, free solver and local Windows deployment. Optional languages/cloud services are not mandatory dependencies.

sections.title: Data acquisition: complete core, optional enrichment
sections.review: Official core plus source-specific optional enrichment, access/coverage/fallback metadata and bounded incremental requests.

sections.title: Data model and temporal correctness
sections.review: Fixture facts and deadline decisions, stable identities, separate clocks, immutable hashes, temporal filtering and missingness.

sections.title: Complete feature and statistic coverage
sections.review: Full available official statistic dictionary and optional enrichment/masks. Features and complexity enter production through measured acceptance, not collection alone.

sections.title: Forecasting methodology
sections.review: Independent reference, component/physical models and trained challengers; accepted future expert connected to production. Changed-rule, availability and shared-world semantics are explicit. Rejected challengers remain comparisons.

sections.title: Contextual intelligence that can be measured
sections.review: Supported structured claims, deduplication, expiry, bounded hypotheses, free eligibility, quota isolation, extraction evaluation and context ablation. Hosted AI never directly changes financial state or authoritative forecasts.

sections.title: The exact rules and account-state engine
sections.review: Versioned official rules, exact account transitions and independent ledger replay; includes prior-transfer restoration and ordinary transfer-hit reversal.

sections.title: Sequential optimization
sections.review: Full registered market, legal incumbents, shared-world rescoring, explicit objectives, terminal values and nonanticipative observable recourse. Approximate search and actual gaps are disclosed.

sections.title: Chip strategy and fixture uncertainty
sections.review: All four chips jointly optimized; each unused entitlement/date receives a whole-policy counterfactual inside the requested horizon. Windows and unknown fixtures are explicit. Full-season horizon covers remaining windows.

sections.title: Elite managers, EO and rivals
sections.review: Prior-qualified elite and current-rank cohorts stay separate; actual retrieval counts, feasible policy branches, EO, joint rival outcomes and disclosed population assumptions.

sections.title: Evaluation that can support competitive claims
sections.review: Chronological purged fitting, independently sealed equal-state legal policy tests, actual returns and source coverage. Future finalized results are necessary for prospective competitiveness; no code change can precompute them.

sections.title: Product experience
sections.review: Squad/market/calendar/chip/captain/research/rival/model/health workspaces, expiring beliefs and structured validated ledger exports.

sections.title: Reliability, security, and operation
sections.review: Durable idempotent jobs, last-good artifacts, stale-input safeguards, local secrets, safe retrieval, backups/restoration, deadline freezing and final/revised results.

sections.title: Delivery plan and acceptance criteria
sections.review: Required source/config/schema/model/report artifacts, CLI/API, original case-family demonstration, clean install and downloaded-package verification. Prospective competitive grade remains determined by future observations.

sections.title: High-value failure cases to test
sections.review: Failure cases reviewed against the rule, integration, chronological and browser suites; new chip-period and restored-account regressions close gaps found in this review.

sections.title: Resource budget and stopping rules
sections.review: Measured bounded source/solver/research budgets, deterministic seeds, runtime/gaps and common-world comparisons; practical limits are reported rather than invented.

sections.title: What has been completed in this research package
sections.review: Historical description of the supplied research package. It is context, not an assertion about implemented or trained software.

sections.title: Mission and nonnegotiable requirements
sections.review: Free local full-season product with exact state, own forecasts, contextual intelligence and evidence-based quality targets.

sections.title: Inputs and immediate user context
sections.review: Dated user seed retained; current public deadline reconciled without pretending it reveals hidden later transfers. General season/account support.

sections.title: First execution sequence
sections.review: Executed source probes, immutable inputs, rules authority, dependency locks and full baseline-to-product vertical slice; retained runtime evidence.

sections.title: Selected technical stack
sections.review: Locked numerical Python/SQL and React/TypeScript stack, compiled free solver, local durable jobs and tests. Optional technology is selected on evidence.

sections.title: Data, identity and provenance
sections.review: Complete official adapters plus extensible source registry, provenance and coverage; source-specific xG, missingness and temporal joins.

sections.title: Required feature coverage
sections.review: Available core/advanced statistics and source masks feed accepted statistical models; optional covariates/challengers require incremental benefit.

sections.title: Independent forecasting engine
sections.review: Multiple trained forecast paths with shared transformations, coherent football alternatives, versioned distributions and validated future-fixture integration; numerical heads are not hosted-LLM output.

sections.title: Hosted contextual intelligence
sections.review: Original-source retrieval, identity/support/expiry checks, free-provider eligibility and extraction quality tests with independent failures and deterministic entry fallback.

sections.title: Exact game/state engine
sections.review: Exact scoring/transitions, chip windows, lot finances, current quotes, FT/hit accounting, restoration, finalized labels and independent export replay.

sections.title: Optimizer and policy engine
sections.review: Full-market multiweek legal policy search, all chips/dates, original user architectures, common-world rescoring, explicit solver bounds and observable scenario recourse.

sections.title: Elite-manager and rival engine
sections.review: Separate qualified/current/active/league samples, actual retrieval disclosure, learned feasible manager policy branches, EO and joint shared-world rival comparisons.

sections.title: Scientific validation
sections.review: Purged chronological training, comparable predictions and continuous accounts, historical/prospective separation, proper scorecards and promotion gates; hindsight only measures oracle regret.

sections.title: Product interface and report contract
sections.review: Complete planner workspaces, all-market inspection, per-week exact ledger, export/deadline calendar and supported contingent recomputation.

sections.title: Operations and failure recovery
sections.review: Atomic durable jobs, bounded retry/quota, cached fallback, local refresh/scheduling, stale-input invalidation, secure retrieval and tested backup/restore.

sections.title: Required artifacts
sections.review: README/locks/config/schema/data/rules/models/optimizer/research/reports/operations artifacts plus implemented CLI/API and independently verified private download.

sections.title: Quality gates
sections.review: Implementation, model and policy gates have concrete checks. Prospective recording/scoring is implemented; future comparative outcomes are explicitly separate acceptance evidence.

sections.title: Working discipline and final reporting
sections.review: Actual tool execution, retained checks and source/runtime verification; final instructions link the built product and report only executed measurements.

review_scope: Every numbered section and every nonblank body line in both supplied design documents is indexed and mapped to implementation evidence. This is a complete source review, not a claim that section mappings prove every possible behavior or future performance.
